test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Two different positions of the same die are shown below. What is the number on the face opposite to the one having 6?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df5c4ce8a819a4c0cdb0c238dbd386f0bde2d54c9c25f342a5ff9843330491cf.png]
solution:
From cube I: The faces with letter 3 and 5 are adjacent to the face with letter 2 in the first position.

From cube II: The faces with letter 4 and 1 are adjacent to the face with letter 2 in the second position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ff0dc5d9185fd8c1524070cc63fde8b3123c06b0549d1f7edbf2b028c16bc2af.png] 

The only letter left is 6.

→ Letter 2 is opposite to letter 6,

→ Letter 3 is opposite to letter 1,

→ Letter 5 is opposite to letter 4.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
